usedFor: Keywords AI keeps prompts with “Create prompt” and “Update prompt”, and reads past logs with “Log list”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated File in specific folder” in Google Drive, then “Update prompt” in Keywords AI
bestTemplate.why: A changed file is a clear cue, and the action updates a prompt to match it.

watchOut: “Delete prompt” removes a prompt, so check which one it points at before it runs.
